newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee strengthens on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee strengthens on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee strengthened against both the dollar and the pound on Friday, reflecting a combination of international trends and central bank intervention, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 19.7985 against the dollar from 19.9040 on Tuesday. The rupee traded at a mean of 33.5430 against the pound from 33.6625 on Tuesday.
Forex dealers said the stronger rupee reflected a combination of the U.S. currency's trend in overnight international markets and central bank intervention on Tuesday.
"But the dollar's overnight trend was the predominant factor in the rupee's fixing," one dealer said.
The dealer added that the central bank sold dollars in the interbank market during an intervention on Tuesday at five cents below the prevailing interbank rate.
"This provided a further support to the rupee during its fixing today," the dealer said.
